marginal running summaries and printed page furniture where independently separable from the OCR body
source page images, publisher advertisements, and catalog pages
the source edition's detailed page-by-page contents list, replaced by an accurate generated chapter-level table of contents

store_set_description: James Anthony Froude's twelve-volume history of Tudor England, from the fall of Cardinal Wolsey to the death of Elizabeth I — the whole run restored and typeset to match.
